objective: Authorize one bounded formal learning train pilot on the fixed medium M-Lab measurement-proxy burst so every declared learning contract can prove natural completion, checkpoint integrity, and V2 metric recomputation before any algorithm comparison claim.
context: This is an eight-cell training-only pilot: paired duplicates for Q-learning/C3, DDQN/C3, DDQN/GAT, and DDQN/MPNN.

The duplicate pairs are deterministic consistency checks under the same trace seed, learning seed, configuration, and control signature; they are not superiority comparisons or final paper statistics.
The pilot is the formal VM gate for the learning paths. Evaluation cells will be compiled and authorized only after these training receipts provide verified checkpoint artifacts.
allowed_inputs: The exact clean main commit containing the compiled matrix
excluded_inputs: Historical runs with a different code, trace, or configuration SHA
Any claim that treats this pilot as algorithm superiority, causal congestion evidence, Q0 optimality, or final paper statistics
deliverables: A machine-recomputed authorization decision bound to the compiled eight-cell training matrix and this finalization
One natural-end VM receipt per training cell with conservation, data/control delivery, resource metrics, and verified nonzero training progress
A checkpoint artifact and metadata SHA for every learning cell, suitable as the declared source for a later evaluation-only matrix
A V2 analysis artifact that recomputes the four duplicate-consistency contrasts from the raw receipts, plus persisted verification
cannot_claim: This pilot does not establish that any algorithm is better than another.
This pilot does not establish a causal congestion-control mechanism, an E0 final threshold, Q0 optimality, or paper-ready statistical generalization.
An engineering run, partial run, or receipt without verified checkpoint lineage cannot be counted as a formal learning result.
acceptance: The authorization binds the exact compiled request, run manifest, analysis request, resolved configs, clean deployed main SHA, and this accepted work finalization.
All eight cells run serially on the same deployed SHA and immutable M-Lab-derived trace identity, ending naturally without OOM or silent fallback.

Each cell has conservation=true, the required control/data delivery evidence, learning.effective=true, train_steps>0, a verified checkpoint, checkpoint SHA and metadata SHA, peak RSS, CPU/thread count, wall time, and steps-per-second.
The four planned duplicate contrasts are recomputed from raw artifacts and persisted verification returns ok=true with no errors.
If any cell fails a gate, execution stops at that cell and the matrix is not treated as a completed pilot until the failure is repaired and the affected cell is rerun.
